findings.strictBarrierSpanningHoleOutcome: wait until original configured deadline, then MEMORY_BARRIER_TIMEOUT; fail or incomplete per policy
findings.scopeEffect: Shared tenant/memorySpace sequence; unrelated later conversation in same scope is also affected.
findings.permanentMeaning: No automatic run/approval/ingestion lifecycle transition closes the hole. Explicit authorized message/conversation/source retirement can remediate; not physically irreparable.
findings.intendedPendingDistinction: Pending is intentional while input approval remains viable. Terminal cancellation removes that approval route yet retains the pending hole; source does not exempt it from later strict scope barriers.

pointers.meaning: Submission registers the unapproved user message before run insertion; waiting_approval run has attempt0.
Pending transcript outbox creates awaiting_approval ingestion event in shared scope sequence; sourceWrite at131 refuses unapproved source.
cancel calls retireWork and recovers queue; approve accepts only waiting_approval (or already-approved replay), so cancelled input cannot later be approved through runs.approve.
retireWork cancels response/outbox/attempt and releases foreground hold; it does not retire input events, transcript bridge or transcript outbox.
Public Agent cancel delegates to runs.cancel and retires owned execution if any; attempt0 has no execution and no ingestion disposition.
Legacy approveMessage also refuses bridges with runId; it is not an alternate approval route for cancelled run input.
Approval of a different run supersedes only that approved message source; it does not retire the cancelled source.
New source advances scope sequence and schedules only eligible event; no global earlier-event gate at this enqueue boundary.
Claim current-event guard refuses eligibility other than eligible; canceled awaiting_approval event has no expiry/recovery claim job.
Facts/vector dependency check is within the current event, not a mechanism to skip earlier scope holes.
V8 captureSelectedCutoff captures complete memory-space sequence, not just approved history or this conversation sequence.
awaiting_approval maps to pending before any stage summary; only trusted skipped eligibility crosses.
readStageProgress scans shared scope sequence to captured cutoff; no cancelled-run or conversation-boundary exception in watermark progress.
Only ineligible/superseded/tombstoned are skipped.
contiguousWatermark stops at pending even if all later events are complete.
Strict context barrier refreshes watermarks and evaluates required stages against captured scope cutoff.
Pending progress waits only until fixed deadline, then MEMORY_BARRIER_TIMEOUT uses configured fail/incomplete behavior.
Ordinary path dispatches directly; strict path uses waiting Workflow. Ordinary success is not a proof shared watermarks recovered.
Explicit authorized message deletion can retire source event through messageOutbox tombstone; editing unapproved input instead creates another pending revision.
Explicit authorized conversation deletion retires exact source events; this is remediation, not normal cancellation disposition.
Trusted source retirement records skipped eligibility and schedules refresh/readiness without approving or indexing input.

reviewedTests.coverage: queued/running cancellation releases queue and denies stale output; no unapproved cancellation followed by ingestion watermarks/strict barrier
awaiting approval has no job/model; explicit approval revision supersedes original event
later completed events cannot cross earlier hole; explicit retirement closes it
strict pending stage waits then times out with no model operation; no cancellation-created hole chain

minimalReproducerProposal: Reuse transcriptFixture and existing inline-barrier fixture; create approval-required conversation A in one owned memory space.

Submit A0, cancel before approval with public registered runtimeAgent.cancel/runs.cancel; assert response cancelled, attempt0, bridge unapproved, source/chunk/vector/model/tool count0 and no ingestion job.

Submit distinct B1 in same conversation and approve B1 only (or use an approved ordinary run in another conversation in same memory space). Capture sequence/cutoff. For same-conversation approval, A0 remains event1, B1 oldrevision2 is superseded, B1 approvedrevision3 eligible.

Use existing controlled ingestion fixture to complete B1 own eligible stages without changing A0; refreshScopeWatermarks/readStageProgress through B1 cutoff. Current source must show facts/vectors hole at A0 despite B1 complete.

Start a distinct strict run in the same memory space with required facts/vectors and bounded100ms onFailure fail; complete its own source stages in controlled fixture to isolate A0. Exercise original startContext/contextBarrier and real Workflow sleep with controlled clock. Current source waits then MEMORY_BARRIER_TIMEOUT; governed response calls remain0.

Repair acceptance should require an explicit trusted non-ingesting terminal disposition for exactly cancelled unapproved A0, contiguous advancement through completed later events, stale approval still denied, cancelled content absent from all sources/context/vectors/tools, idempotent cancellation, foreign-scope denial and rollback. Never weaken contiguousWatermark or mark stages falsely complete.
